content.short: Tiger Society is an NFT project on the Cardano blockchain that will have an RPG Lite type game with P2E mechanics.
content.description:
At Tiger Society, our primary mission is to provide utility for our NFTs and create value for our community. To achieve this we are creating a 3d mobile Tiger Society game designed to seamlessly integrate Tiger Society NFTs with the gaming mechanics to enhance the player experience and reward Tiger Society NFT holders.

We also have a Launchpad service that has successfully launched the OGBears and the OGVerse project.
